name: Kairaku Sex de Otosareteita Ai Suru Tsuma ~Hoka no Otoko no Te de Mi mo Kokoro mo Iki Kurutteiku Saiaizuma
original_name: 快楽セックスで堕とされていた愛する妻 ～他の男の手で身も心もイキ狂っていく最愛妻
source:
Shiro and Mio have been friends since childhood. They
grew up together like brother and sister, and as they matured in body and mind, they became aware of each other as the opposite sex,
spending their youth as lovers, and then getting married after graduating.

Childhood friends, lovers, and now husband and wife -
the relationship they had as a couple changed over time, but
they had always been so close since they were little that their friends, and even their parents, thought of them as a set.

They themselves hoped that this happy relationship would continue forever - that it would continue forever.

- Then, one day, Tatsumi comes to the store where Mio works as the manager.

Mio has a good impression of Tatsumi, who is earnest and a gentleman.
...However, that "good impression" soon begins to take on a different color.

Mio has always had eyes for and feelings for one man.

For the first time, she feels an irresistible wavering in her heart, and eventually...

translation:
白和澪从小就是朋友。他们
像兄妹一样一起长大，随着身心的成熟，他们开始意识到彼此是异性，
青春期是恋人，毕业后结婚。

儿时的朋友，恋人，现在的夫妻——
他们作为情侣的关系随着时间的推移而改变，但是
他们从小就关系非常亲密，以至于他们的朋友，甚至他们的父母，都认为他们是一个整体。

他们自己也希望这种幸福的关系能够永远持续下去——永远持续下去。

- 然后，有一天，辰巳来到澪担任经理的商店。

澪对认真且绅士的辰巳印象很好。
……然而，这种“好印象”很快就开始呈现出不同的颜色。

澪一直对一个男人有眼光，有感情。

她第一次感觉到内心有一种不可抗拒的动摇，最终……
